headline: OCEANAGOLD SWALLOWS AUSGOLD IN A$776M DEAL — KATANNING GOLD PROJECT BECOMES FIFTH ASSET
snippet: OceanaGold Corporation (TSX/ASX: OGC) announced August 17 a definitive scheme implementation deed to acquire 100% of Ausgold Limited — owner of the Katanning Gold Project in Western Australia — valuing Ausgold equity at A$776 million (US$549 million), or A$1.36 per Ausgold share. Shareholders receive 0.03365 OceanaGold shares per Ausgold share held, with an optional cash election capped at A$194 million; deal expected to close December 2026 pending regulatory and shareholder approval. Katanning becomes OceanaGold's fifth asset alongside Haile (South Carolina), Macraes and Waihi (New Zealand), and Didipio (Philippines) — adding a low-capital open-pit gold development project in a premier jurisdiction to a portfolio already generating record cash at current gold prices above $4,300.

headline: LME COPPER BACKWARDATION HITS $543/T — 42ND STRAIGHT DAY OF INVENTORY DECLINE, EMERGENCY MEASURES TRIGGERED
snippet: The LME copper cash/3-month spread widened to $543.50 per tonne on August 17 — the most extreme near-term supply squeeze since the 2021 copper market crunch — as LME registered inventory declined for the 42nd consecutive trading day to approximately 204,975 tonnes, with nearly half of remaining stocks already earmarked for immediate withdrawal. The London Metal Exchange introduced emergency measures to contain the runaway spot premium as traders competed for prompt metal. This LME physical squeeze is categorically different from the COMEX tariff-positioning spike that hit $6.90/lb in early August: 42 consecutive days of drawdown reflects structural supply constraints — DRC concentrate export ban, Codelco setbacks, AI and grid demand — translating into real-world competition for available copper today.

headline: ARIZONA EAGLE EXTENDS McCabe SILVER CORRIDOR 50% — THREE PAST-PRODUCING MINES CONSOLIDATE EAGLE SILVER PROJECT
snippet: Arizona Eagle Mining Corp. (TSX-V: AZEM) completed August 17 the acquisition of 62 acres of patented land hosting three past-producing high-grade silver mines — the Arizona National Mine, the Lookout Mine, and the Silver Belt Mine — located approximately one kilometre northeast of the company's McCabe gold-silver deposit. The acquisitions extend the McCabe mineralised corridor from 3 kilometres to 4.5 kilometres (a 50% increase) and raise patented land ownership from 348 to 410 acres, with an operating water well included. At $65+ silver, the economics of systematically re-evaluating historic high-grade silver workings adjacent to a proven deposit through modern drilling and geophysics have not been stronger in a generation.

headline: PREMIER AMERICAN URANIUM: 13 OF 22 KAYCEE HOLES HIT — MULTIPLE URANIUM TRENDS IDENTIFIED IN WYOMING POWDER RIVER BASIN
snippet: Premier American Uranium Inc. reported August 17 that 13 of 22 holes drilled in the Rustler target area at its Kaycee Project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin have intersected uranium mineralization at grades of 0.02% eU₃O₈ or higher — mid-season results from an ongoing 100,000-foot 2026 exploration program that have identified multiple mineralised uranium trends to direct the back half of the campaign. Wyoming's Powder River Basin is the most active ISR uranium exploration jurisdiction in the US; 13-of-22 hole hit rates confirm the roll-front deposit geometry that makes Powder River Basin targets amenable to low-cost in-situ recovery at current uranium spot prices near $86/lb.

headline: GOLDGROUP (GORO) DRILLS 25,726M IN 7 MONTHS AT DON DAVID — ARISTA AND ALTA GRACIA UNDERGROUND EXPANSION HIGHLIGHTED
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSX-V: GORO) released August 17 selected drill results from its Don David Gold Mine complex in Oaxaca, Mexico — reporting 25,726 metres completed across 123 holes over the seven months ended July 31, 2026, primarily infill and expansion work at the producing Arista and Alta Gracia underground mines. The Taviche Oeste district's structural gold-silver vein system has demonstrated down-dip and along-strike continuity that rewards systematic drilling; running 25,000+ metres annually at a producing gold-silver operation in the current $4,300+ gold, $65+ silver price environment signals management confidence in extending mine life and expanding the resource inventory at margins that make exploration capital highly accretive.

headline: CHINA'S CRITICAL MINERALS ARSENAL IS BACK — LICENSING BELOW 25% FOR WESTERN BUYERS, SECOND WAVE HITS NOVEMBER
snippet: InvestorNews' August 16 Critical Minerals Report identifies converging supply shocks that confirm the bull market has structurally arrived: China's rare earth export licensing approval rate has fallen below 25% for European buyers; Beijing simultaneously plans to increase mine output at its largest rare earth deposit by 50% while restricting exports — controlling processing while maintaining upstream scarcity for non-Chinese manufacturers; Congo has banned copper and cobalt concentrate exports; the Trump administration blocks all US tungsten scrap and battery waste exports effective August 27 (the US has zero active tungsten mines); and China's second-wave export controls on five additional rare earth elements — holmium, erbium, thulium, europium, and ytterbium — take effect November 10, 2026, giving Western defence and industrial buyers under 90 days to find alternative supply chains that do not yet exist at commercial scale.

headline: PROSPECTIVA RESOURCES (PSVA) DEBUTS ON TSX-V — C$3.68M-FUNDED DRILL CAMPAIGN UNDERWAY IN BRAZIL'S BORBOREMA BELT
snippet: Prospectiva Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: PSVA) began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange August 14, 2026 following its qualifying transaction with Pentagon I Capital Corp, with C$3.68 million raised to fund exploration at its wholly-owned Borborema project portfolio in Brazil's Pernambuco and Paraiba states. ServDrill has been contracted for a drill programme targeting historical high-grade near-surface copper-gold mineralisation at the São Francisco Copper-Gold Project across a 3-kilometre structural trend, with the programme specifically designed to test newly identified electromagnetic conductors. The Borborema Belt in northeast Brazil is an underexplored geological province with documented copper-gold mineralisation and improving infrastructure access; with copper above $6.60/lb and gold above $4,300, the São Francisco project's mixed copper-gold endowment is being drilled in the most favourable commodity price environment in the asset's history.
